issues.title_en: Hundreds of migrants in Spain's Ceuta enclave protest for asylum, against deportation to Morocco
issues.summary: Hundreds of migrants who recently entered Spain's North African enclave of Ceuta staged a protest on a popular urban beach on Sunday, urging Spanish authorities to grant them asylum instead of sending them back to Morocco.
